row.title: Server-side only: gates settle in the Worker; desktop session-sweeper paused
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-20 restated server-side only: no path may assume a client-side code agent. Measured: serverside --check ok, loopowner --check ok, executor runs in GitHub Actions (6 of 6 recent runs success). The desktop-app task session-sweeper (every 20 min on a personal computer) is paused; session-reaper keeps its server route (boundary --reap in CI). Gate settling gains a Worker route (dashboard settledLive, http evidence, 1 h Cache API) beside watchdog.yml.
